text.description_html:
RK International CK-4248, Retro Two-Toned Cabinet Knob

Though the age of sleek diners and soda shoppes is over, it doesn't mean that the slick style of that era has to be gone too. RK International's Retro Cabinet Knob with Riveted Brass Top brings the best of the chrome-filled diners of days gone by and condenses it into one contemporary knob. It is available in two finishes: chrome with brass and oil rubbed bronze with brass. Either one will surely make your poodle-skirt fly up.

Also Available: Matching Deco Two-Toned Cabinet Pull

Specifications and Features of the RK International CK-4248 Cabinet Knob with Riveted Brass Top:

  • Material: Brass
  • Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Polished Chrome with Polished Brass

Oil Rubbed Bronze with Polished Brass

Sold Individually
